Vercel AI SDK Tutorial · Updated Jan 5, 2025
Learn how to connect Vercel's AI SDK to local or remote models using OpenAI-compatible APIs, featuring LM Studio integration on localhost.
You can use Vercel's AI SDK to connect to locally running models. In fact, not just locally running models but models running at any URL.
